title: Creative Delivery Metrics
description: Delivery metrics row for one creative within a package: the delivery the seller measured for that creative, not a share of the package total divided across the package's creatives.

creative_id.description: The creative's creative_id in the seller's creative library, matching the creative assignment and list_creatives: the buyer's ID for a creative the buyer synced, or the seller-assigned ID for a creative that entered the library outside sync_creatives (for example, an ad made in the seller platform's own tools). The platform's own identifier is list_creatives platform_id, not this field. A seller-assigned ID stays the same across reports only when the seller declares creative.stable_creative_ids.

creative_name.description: Optional human-readable creative name current when the report is generated. Convenience metadata only: names may change and buyers MUST use creative_id as the stable identity.

weight.description: Observed delivery share for this creative within the package during the reporting period, expressed as a percentage (0-100). Reflects actual delivery distribution, not a configured setting.
